blind_spots: The exact coordinate realization of Eliahou's 64-modular seed is not reconstructed in this artifact set; a future implementation still has to rebuild it.
No concept here proves that local defect motion is sufficient to cross the final barrier from modular to exact orthogonality.
The translation from CA-generated Latin-square style designs into 167-length witness data may be empty in practice and needs aggressive small-order falsification.
The formal-language interpretation of 'cellar automata' is plausible but not standard terminology for this problem, so it should remain a side branch rather than the main claim.
Compute-cost estimates are still rough; some concepts may only be practical if heavy symmetry reduction and incremental scoring are implemented first.

anomaly_results.constraint: Rule updates must preserve exact support weight 80 at every step.
anomaly_results.effect: Several flashy CA ideas collapse into conservative particle-swap dynamics, which is actually useful because it aligns them with the exact cyclic obstruction.
Most defect-lift concepts become too myopic; the viable path shifts toward pushdown filtering or SAT-guided motif learning.

anomaly_results.constraint: The modular seed is unavailable and search must start cold.
anomaly_results.effect: Defect-transport concepts lose their main advantage and spectral or exact-filter concepts become the better first bet.

anomaly_results.constraint: Exact verification is expensive and can only run every N steps.
